nom: La Roche-Posay Lipikar AP+M Triple Repair Body Moisturizing Cream for Dry Skin

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, very dry, or postpartum/winter dry skin report the cream relieves flaking, cracking, and pain and keeps skin moisturized through the day, though one reviewer with dry skin saw flakiness return the next day.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including those with eczema, report the fragrance-free formula soothes patches and reduces redness/irritability without triggering reactions, but one reviewer with acne-prone sensitive skin reacted with itching and redness on the chest.
segments.combination: One reviewer with extra oily-then-extra dry (hormonal acne-prone) skin reports it worked well in both states and restored her barrier.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin found it lightweight enough to absorb well despite being marketed for dry skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers describing mature or aging skin report visible softening and reduced appearance of lines, with one crediting it for turning back the clock.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using the cream on mature skin report smoother texture and reduced appearance of fine lines and stretch marks over time; no dissent noted.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, especially those with dry or very dry skin, report deep, long-lasting hydration and relief from flaking, cracking, and painful dryness; one reviewer nonetheless reports flaky skin the next day.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with sensitive skin or eczema report less redness and calmer, soothed patches; one reviewer instead developed redness and irritation after applying it to the chest.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers combining it with retinol/tretinoin report it prevented redness, purging, and peeling and restored the skin barrier; no negative barrier reports were found.
concerns.spots: Reviewers with psoriasis or eczema report healed, less painful cracked hands and disappearing patches within days.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and even fewer breakouts over time; one reviewer with cystic acne reports the product caused new whiteheads and breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin found it absorbed well without feeling heavy; another mature-skin reviewer noted the cream is slightly oily but felt it suited her needs.

aspects.libelle: Good value for large bottle size
Greasy or oily smell on first use

extraits.texte: This 100% causes my face to break out, most likely due to the fact thag shea butter is the third ingredient in this. I have cystic acne and do not develop small white heads unless its from a product, and this absolutely causes break outs for me. Next issue Im thinking is caused by the niacinamide. I slather my chest with two different lotions before bed, this being one of them. Last night, i did not mix this lotion with the other. My chest itched this morning, didnt really think anything of it. A few hours later i go to shower, and my chest is red and irritated where i had applied the lotion last night. I dont think this is a bad product if you have the type of skin that can tolerate it. However my acne prone and sensitive skin does not like this at all

I struggle with severe hormonal acne-prone skin. I have to be very careful to find a the delicate balance between exfoliating that dead skin and unclogging my pores while not stripping my skin and making it more inflamed. This moisturizer has been AMAZING. when my skin is extra oily, it works great. When my skin is extra dry, it works great. My barrier has been restored and I'm so happy!

extraits.titre: Perfect for sensitive, dry, eczema prone skin
extraits.texte: This cream doesn't leave a greasy residue and it's perfect for very sensitive, dry, eczema prone skin. My boyfriend uses it daily after the shower and it has made his facial eczema patches disappear. Will continue to purchase!

I've been using this moisturizer for almost two weeks after seeing so many good reviews. I have oily skin, so I was searching for a lightweight moisturizer suitable for my skin. The description says for dry skin, but my oily skin loves it too. I feel it really soaks into my skin and a little goes a long way. Friendly price for sh a big bottle!
Since beginning tret, this moisturizer prevents all side effects. No redness, purging, mild peeling. Lasts a long time and you get a lot for the price point.

I can not tell you how great this lotion is. Seriously I have no words except for RUN… GET IT… NOW!! I have been using this lotion daily after showering from my face all the way down to my feet and I have NEVER felt so moisturized. Not only is the moisturizing top notch but it is literally making my lines on my face and my stretch marks on my stomach and inner thighs DISAPPEAR. Seriously this stuff is amazing. It only takes 8 pumps to cover my entire body from top to bottom which makes this so economical. It is very thick so it does take a little time to pump it out but it is worth every second believe me. I wish it was the exact same formula in a tub instead of a pump bottle but I guess we can't have everything. I have recommended this to so many people since I started using it. I am 50 years old and I think it's turning back the hands of time for me. Get it ladies and gentlemen!!
Product feels good at first, but I've noticed my skin is flaky the next day. I've never experienced that with moisturizers from other brands. I find it okay for body, but will avoid for face.
